lever_request: INSERT INTO cf_agent_requests (requester, kind, prompt, instance, priority) SELECT 'program-manager:' || m.program_code, 'run', 'You are the program manager of ' || m.program_code || ' in the QNFO fleet. Metric ' || m.metric_key || ' (trigger #' || m.trigger_id || ', breach when ' || m.operator || ' ' || m.threshold || ') reads ' || COALESCE(m.val, '?') || ' now and ' || COALESCE(m.val_7d, '?') || ' seven days ago, so its remedy has not moved it (METRIC-CLOSED-LOOP-1: a remedy that did not move its metric in 7 days is replaced, not repeated). Its open issue is #' || m.open_issue_id || '. The current lever: ' || substr(COALESCE((SELECT a.action FROM analytics_metric_triggers a WHERE a.id = m.trigger_id), ''), 1, 1200) || char(10) || 'Read the metric''s formula and source_of_truth in qnfo-audit.metric_registry, the producer''s code in the qnfo-workers repository and the issue. Return at most 250 words in exactly one form, with no tool-status text: ROOT CAUSE: <producer or cause>; code-task: repo=qnfo-workers path=<file>; code-anchor: <unique verbatim line>; EDIT: <exact change>. OR ROOT CAUSE: <cause>; CORRECTED TARGET: <operator and value>; EVIDENCE: <why the current target is wrong, from its formula or source>. A response without the required lever fields is not accepted and will be requested again.', 'lever-' || m.trigger_id || '-' || strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M', 'now'), 'medium' FROM metric_improvement_now m WHERE m.verdict IN ('breach-worsening', 'breach-flat') AND m.open_issue_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cf_agent_requests r WHERE r.instance LIKE 'lever-' || m.trigger_id || '-%' AND (r.status IN ('queued', 'running') OR (r.created_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-3 days') AND ((COALESCE(r.result, '') LIKE '%code-task: repo=qnfo-workers path=%' AND COALESCE(r.result, '') LIKE '%code-anchor:%' AND COALESCE(r.result, '') LIKE '%EDIT:%') OR (COALESCE(r.result, '') LIKE '%CORRECTED TARGET:%' AND COALESCE(r.result, '') LIKE '%EVIDENCE:%')) AND r.status = 'done'))) AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'persona_actions'), 'on') <> 'off' ORDER BY m.priority, CASE m.verdict WHEN 'breach-worsening' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.trigger_id LIMIT 5
rm_file: INSERT INTO agent_issues (title, description, source, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'ROADMAP-1: ' || p.program_code || ' #' || p.id || ': ' || p.title, 'code-task: repo=qnfo-workers path=' || p.path || char(10) || p.anchor_line || char(10) || char(10) || 'Manager-originated roadmap item (ROADMAP-ORIGINATE-1, owner directive 2026-10-26: the fleet managers research, build, implement and deploy roadmaps that improve features, functionality and quality). Proposed by the program manager of ' || p.program_code || ' from Cloudflare agent research (' || p.request_instance || ').' || char(10) || 'Definition of done: the change is merged and verified live by the canonical deploy (code_tasks merge_state verified); the managers then close this issue with the pull request as evidence and record the outcome in roadmap_proposals.' || char(10) || char(10) || p.rationale, 'management-personas', 'feature', 'high', 'open', CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 FROM roadmap_proposals p WHERE p.status = 'proposed' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues i WHERE i.status = 'open' AND i.title LIKE 'ROADMAP-1: ' || p.program_code || ' #%') < 3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues i WHERE i.title LIKE 'ROADMAP-1: ' || p.program_code || ' #' || p.id || ':%') AND instr(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'code_merge_trusted_sources'), ''), 'management-personas|ROADMAP-1:') > 0 AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'persona_actions'), 'on') <> 'off' AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'roadmap_originate'), 'on') <> 'off'
pl_research_tail: char(10) || 'EDIT: <the exact change, under 120 words>', 'roadmap-' || r.program_code || '-plus-' || r.product || '-' || strftime('%Y%m%d', 'now'), 'medium' FROM v_product_plus_due d JOIN product_registry r ON r.product = d.product WHERE d.in_flight = 0
